title: Change proposal (orchestrator-only-writes pilot)
description: What a non-orchestrator agent returns instead of editing a file. Applied by `agentteams --apply-proposal FILE`; the agent identity comes from the orchestrator-issued `dispatch` nonce, not from this document.

base_sha256.description: sha256 of the file the agent read, or "absent" for a new file.

gates.description: Registered gates to run (matching gates also run).

agent.description: Optional; must equal the agent the dispatch nonce was issued to, else the artifact is refused.

dispatch.description: The dispatch nonce from `agentteams --issue-dispatch`; the agent is read from its signed record.
